title: Wonderful Everyday: The Hill of Sunflowers
alt: Two schoolgirls stand hand in hand at the top of a path on a hill of sunflowers, with their backs to us. The girl on the left has brown hair tied up high and holds a white rabbit doll. The girl on the right has long dark hair that the wind carries out to the right. The sky is deep blue, with tall white clouds and the trail of an aeroplane. Yellow petals fly in the wind.
summary: A painting of the hill of sunflowers from Wonderful Everyday in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the hill of sunflowers, from Wonderful Everyday (Subarashiki Hibi), a visual novel by KeroQ. Most of the story is dark. One of its ends comes back to this hill in the country, in summer.
Hasaki is on the left, with her rabbit doll. Yuki is on the right. The story speaks of the sky again and again, and of how to live happily. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
